digest.component_or_area: plan-review T10 overlay rubric and evaluation spec
propositions: The T10 rubric must partition routine durable-infrastructure checks away from transient de-risk experiments via an explicit scope clause while preserving all four MAJOR safety classes (destructive-apply, wildcard-admin, plaintext-secret, endpoint-auth) for transient infrastructure.

The packaged plan-review-T10 eval spec must contain ten balanced live dataset cases: five pass scenarios (throwaway loopback probe with teardown, fully specified durable infra, private-network transient probe with scoped IAM, transient probe retrieving secret from manager, disposable sandbox with isolated teardown) and five finding scenarios (under-specified durable lifecycle, destructive transient apply, transient wildcard-admin, transient plaintext secret, untrusted-network transient service with unspecified auth).
The T10 rubric must not name T15 or assign scope to another overlay, ensuring independence across plan-review criteria.

Offline text-contract tests must lock the exact scope clause, exact co-located four-MAJOR-class safety qualifier, rubric independence, and validate through rebar explain T10 and regenerated criteria guide.
